title: A logarithmic independence bound for clique-free graphs
summary: For every fixed integer r ≥ 4, every K r -free graph on n vertices with average degree d ≥ 2 has an independent set of size at least $`c_r n\log d/d`$, where $`c_r\gt 0`$ depends only on r . This proves the fixed-clique-size independence conjecture of Ajtai, Erdős, Komlós and Szemerédi.
